role: Split out of DataPurgeService.swift: the purge's preferences sweep — which UserDefaults keys a full wipe removes from the app's own suite and the App Group suite (sweepAllDefaults over PurgeScope.defaultsDomains, by default deviceDefaultsDomains) and which it keeps (the entitlement / StoreKit keep-list, the migration flags, system-owned prefixes).
types: DataPurgeService: extension (@MainActor, from the enum) — preferences sweep
state: mem:DataPurgeService.defaultsKeepList = entitlement.anchor.account, entitlement.anchor.v1, storekit.lastKnownPurchased, storekit.lastKnownTestFlight, storekit.verifiedProductionInstall, storekit.verifiedXcodeInstall
mem:DataPurgeService.systemOwnedPrefixes (Apple, NS, com.apple., WebKit, AK, PK, MSV, INNext, CarCapabilities, ADPrivacy, METAL, GEO, TVRemote, SU)
ud:<bundle id> persistent domain and the App Group suite (AppConfig.appGroupIdentifier): every key not kept is removed
toplevel: Two private static let tables (defaultsKeepList, systemOwnedPrefixes). deviceDefaultsDomains and sweepAllDefaults are internal: DataPurgeService.swift calls them (PurgeScope.device, purgeAllUserData); the rest are private to this file.

units.does: False for keys on the keep list, FlowRecovery.migration.* keys, didRun* keys that carry a _v version marker, and system-owned keys (isSystemKey: a system prefix followed by a capital, digit, underscore or nothing); true otherwise.

True when key starts with prefix and either the prefix ends with '.', the key is exactly the prefix, or the next character is uppercase, a digit or '_' (Apple's key style); a lowercase continuation is not a system key.

branches.cond: prefix ends with '.' or nothing follows it

units.does: The device's preference suites for PurgeScope.device: (name, store) for the standard suite (bundle id) and the App Group suite, appending an error for any unavailable.

branches.effect: adds standard suite; else error 'no bundle identifier'
adds group suite; else error 'app group suite unavailable'

units.does: Removes every purgeable key from the scope's preference suites (the device's standard and App Group suites in production), returning the count removed.
reads: ud:* (the scope's suites; standard and App Group in production)
writes: ud:* (the scope's suites; standard and App Group in production)

branches.cond: for each domain the scope lists

units.does: Keys stored in a suite: its persistent domain keys if available, else dictionaryRepresentation minus global/argument/registration domain keys.

branches.effect: returns its keys; else filtered dictionaryRepresentation (App Group case)

units.does: Union of global persistent-domain, argument-domain and registration-domain keys of UserDefaults.standard.
